newsitem.title: USA: Charleston Cty, S.C., rejects $85 mln bond issue.
newsitem.headline: Charleston Cty, S.C., rejects $85 mln bond issue.

text.p: Charleston County Council has rejected an $85 million bond issue to finance renovation of a building to be used by the Medical University of South Carolina, county officials said on Friday.

The tax-exempt revenue bond was voted down 6-2 in a preliminary vote on Thursday. The building in question was previously the site of St Francis Xavier Hospital, which has moved to a West Ashley site.
The university and a physicians practice group, University Medical Associates, had sought conduit financing from the county, which would have no obligation to pay debt service.

The tax-exempt bond proposal was criticized by a group of private practice physicians who oppose Medical University's plan to lease its hospitals to Columbia/HCA Healthcare Corp, a for-profit company.
The vote went against the advice of the county attorney, who noted that the council had approved similar arrangements in the past for St. Francis Xavier and Roper hospitals.
The bond issue could be reconsidered at a council meeting on Tuesday, county officials said. Approval of the issue would require three votes by the council.
